name: forgejo-cli
description: Use when managing a Forgejo or Gitea server from the terminal: issues, pull requests, repositories, file contents, labels, milestones, releases, webhooks, user settings, or any /api/v1 endpoint through a safe generic API command. Do not use this skill for unrelated requests; route to the nearest named specialist.

findings.excerpt: python3 scripts/forgejo-cli issue list --owner acme --repo app --json
